message.content:
The Royal Spa Centre was officially opened on 15 June 1972 by Anthony Eden. According to the source [Royal Spa Centre], Anthony Eden was a one time MP for Leamington and Warwick and Prime Minister of the UK. The source [Anthony Eden] confirms he was a British Conservative politician. Therefore, the political party of the man who opened the centre is the Conservative Party (UK).

Final answer: Conservative Party (UK)
